about.text: Rouaba is Chad's traditional cultured milk, a sour buttermilk. The milk is matured about 24 hours at room temperature in a closed container, then shaken in a gourd until butter separates, and the buttermilk is drunk at once; one source says it is mixed with wheat porridge.
